name: dotnet-endpoint
description: Full .NET API endpoint: DTOs, service method, controller action, and xUnit tests

agents.task: Create the request and response DTO classes for the new endpoint. Follow the project's existing naming conventions (e.g. XxxRequest / XxxResponse or XxxDto). Add data annotations for validation where appropriate. Place them in the correct Models or DTOs folder.

Add the business logic method to the appropriate service class (or create a new one if needed). Inject the required dependencies via constructor. Include proper error handling, logging, and return the response DTO. Register the service in DI if it is new.

Add the controller action method. Use the correct HTTP verb attribute ([HttpGet]/[HttpPost]/etc.), route template, and [FromBody]/[FromQuery] bindings. Validate ModelState. Call the service and return appropriate ActionResult<T>. Follow existing controller patterns in the project.

Write xUnit tests for the controller and service. Use Moq to mock dependencies. Cover: happy path, validation failures, service throwing exceptions, correct HTTP status codes returned by the controller.
